settingsSchema.label: Keep RPC active (--rpc)
settingsSchema.description: Keeps FS RPC active in Core only mode. IZlauncher and IZPSlauncher manage their own sessions.

settingsSchema.label: FS endpoint (--rpc)
settingsSchema.description: Run the upstream FS acquisition before graphics and retain its endpoint. Requires a fresh console launch.
